title: Synapse contrarian golden-suite and CI canary for streaming, tool-calls, and structured-output compatibility
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Build a reproducible conformance harness ("Synapse") and CI canary that validates compatibility across streaming responses, function/tool calling flows, and structured-output schema assertions. Synapse will centralize golden prompt seeds, contrarian edge-case variants, and a multi-delta contract validator that detects regressions in ordering, partial JSON emissions, tool-call interleaving, and KV-cache priming effects.

Scope: 1) Golden corpus generation: create ~600 seeds covering short/long context, interleaved tool calls, nested function outputs, partial JSON streams, and backpressure scenarios. 2) Contract assertions: strict schema validators plus permissive fallback checks for legacy clients; fingerprinting to detect behavioral drift rather than token-level diffs. 3) CI integration: fast smoke suite for PRs (~60s) and nightly heavy run with statistical baselining. 4) Canary rollout: pre-release canary that runs staged traffic against new runtime/model variants with automated rollback on regressions.

Acceptance criteria: - Golden corpus committed and versioned in repo with provenance notes. - Contract checks implemented: ordering assertions, json-roundtrip/idempotency, toolcall-acknowledgement and idempotent retries. - PR gate: smoke run passes <= 3 flaky tests; any new failures create a blocking issue. - Nightly baseline run generates a fingerprint diff report and sends alerts when similarity < 0.92 for high-impact scenarios. - End-to-end canary traffic pipeline configured and documented in Confluence.

Implementation notes and trade-offs: - We'll favor fingerprint-based behavioral checks (embedding + similarity) to reduce brittle token diffs, but keep token-diff tooling for deterministic infra bugs. - Golden prompts include intentionally 'contrarian' permutations (out-of-order tool calls, truncated JSON, delayed tool acknowledgements) to surface edge-case regressions early. - To keep PR latency low, split suite into 'smoke' (PR), 'canary' (merge-time), and 'nightly' (regression signal). - Instrumentation will emit per-test metrics to Prometheus and a dedicated dashboard in Console for traceability.

Artifacts: - Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/synapse/pull/142 - Design doc (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Synapse+Conformance+Harness - Golden corpus (Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/folder/synapse-gold

2025-02-28 - Design review (Liam O'Reilly): Suggested additional scenarios for multi-tool race conditions and ambiguous JSON fragments; approved inclusion in golden corpus.
